mapper.select: SELECT category AS category, COALESCE(SUM( CASE WHEN transaction_date BETWEEN #{currentStartDate} AND #{currentEndDate} THEN amount ELSE 0 END ), 0) AS currentAmount, COALESCE(SUM( CASE WHEN transaction_date BETWEEN #{previousStartDate} AND #{previousEndDate} THEN amount ELSE 0 END ), 0) AS previousAmount FROM TRANSACTIONS WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND type = 'EXPENSE' AND category NOT IN ('INCOME', 'SEND', 'CARD_WITHDRAWAL') AND transaction_date BETWEEN #{previousStartDate} AND #{currentEndDate} GROUP BY category ORDER BY category ASC
